text:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER fired for gpu-pool-west2b -> PagerDuty PD-98132 created (severity: high). Reason: repeated CUDA OOM (CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY) across multiple alloc attempts on node gpu-west2b-12. Auto-evac attempted.

maria_ops: seeing the PD page. grabbing it now. any initial customer impact numbers?

casey_pager: PD alert shows 28% of requests to west2b are getting 5xx/gpu-fallback. Top 3 affected customers: search-alpha, summarizer-inc, chatlytics. latency for those flows spiked to ~3-8s.

raj_oncall: acked PD-98132 :white_check_mark: i'm oncall for the region, pulling logs now

luis_sre: logs show repeated allocation failures and fragmentation: here's the last alloc trace:
```
[2026-03-15T02:13:42Z] cudaMalloc failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY size=2147483648
[2026-03-15T02:13:42Z] Model: redwood-13b-mlq, seq_len: 2048, batch: 8
[2026-03-15T02:13:42Z] KV cache pressure -> evict attempt returned 0 entries
```
looks like a KV-cache prefetch storm + long seq lengths. not a single runaway job, more of many medium jobs stacking.

alex_infra: confirming capacity footprint: pool west2b currently at 94% GPU mem util across active nodes. We have 2 spare nodes in standby, can bring up 4 more if we hot-add. can do an immediate scale and evict heavy-prefetch pods.

raj_oncall: proposed mitigation 1) disable KV-prefetch for affected model family 2) evict/restart top offender pods 3) route low-priority workloads to cpu-fallback pool 4) scale + add 4 GPUs to west2b.

maria_ops: how do we disable prefetch quickly? is there a runtime flag?

luis_sre: yes — runtime toggle: `prefetch.enabled=false` on the model route. patch looks like:
```
PATCH /routes/redwood-13b-mlq
{"runtime": {"kvcache": {"prefetch": false}}}
```

casey_pager: if we flip prefetch, expect some quality regression for long contexts on a few customers. notify CS. but it will stop the allocation churn.

alex_infra: i'm running eviction on the top 6 pods by mem usage now: `kubectl -n infer delete pod $(kubectl ... | head -6)` — will sequentially drain them to avoid mass evict.

incident-bot: action recorded -> eviction job started by alex_infra at 2026-03-15T02:18:05Z

raj_oncall: routing rule changed for non-critical routes -> `route:cpu-fallback` applied to tag low-priority. verifying traffic shift...

maria_ops: observed immediate drop in GPU alloc failures after first 2 evictions. errors reduced from ~120/min to ~18/min. still seeing some OOMs correlated with a specific pod set (user-session-*).

luis_sre: digging into session jobs — found a runaway batch job from run-id 7e4b that keeps prefetching 20k tokens. tagging it as culprit.

alex_infra: isolating run-id 7e4b: cordoning node gpu-west2b-12, migrating pods off that node to empty it.

casey_pager: CS notified: message sent to affected customers saying we're mitigating and may have short degraded quality. they asked to be CC'd when fully resolved.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98132 acknowledged by raj_oncall at 2026-03-15T02:19:12Z

raj_oncall: escalated to SEV-2 due to multi-customer impact. paging oncall-sre@ for 2nd-level assistance.

luis_sre: quick config change done to reduce per-request KV-window from 4 -> 2, applying to redwood-13b-mlq. patch applied.

maria_ops: mem util now stable at ~72% across pool. 5xxs dropped to <2% for most customers. search-alpha still showing occasional spikes.

alex_infra: scale request submitted: adding 4 x A100-sim nodes (warm start) ETA ~6 mins. also added scheduling preference to prioritize small-seq jobs on older GPUs.

maria_ops: handoff time in 20m — raj, do you want me to take postmortem or you?

raj_oncall: i'll stay for the hotfix and postmortem. maria, please own customer comms + timeline doc.

casey_pager: creating incident ticket INC-2026-175 in tracker with remediation steps and rollback plan. link: https://tracker/redwood/INC-2026-175

luis_sre: follow-up actions:
- full root-cause runbook step: kvcache-prefetch throttle default needs lower cap
- add monitoring alert for KV-prefetch rate per-route
- add per-tenant long-context detection and auto-throttle

alex_infra: scale completed at 2026-03-15T02:25:48Z, 4 nodes online. traffic rebalanced.

incident-bot: AUTOPAGER auto-suppression engaged — error rate below threshold for 10min. will close PD if stable for 15m.

raj_oncall: marking PD for monitoring. keeping SEV-2 open until tomorrow 09:00 UTC for follow-ups.

maria_ops: customer update posted to support tickets and CX Slack. will sync with product for any perf regression notes.

casey_pager: post-incident checklist filled, assigning follow-ups to luis_sre (kvcache tuning), alex_infra (autoscale warm pool), maria_ops (customer comms). due EOD.

raj_oncall: thanks all. TL;DR: KV-prefetch storm + long contexts caused fragmentation -> automated paging -> evict offending pods + disable prefetch + scale pool -> errors normalized. next: throttle prefetch by default and add per-route caps.

luis_sre: leaving a short reproduction snippet in the ticket for engineering: `python stress_prefetch.py --model redwood-13b-mlq --concurrency 40 --seq 2048`

maria_ops: last check 2026-03-15T02:40:05Z: all major customer flows healthy. closing channel if no objections in 5.

alex_infra: +1

casey_pager: +1

raj_oncall: closing thread at 2026-03-15T02:41:02Z. follow-ups in INC-2026-175.

incident-bot: Thread closed by raj_oncall. PD-98132 set to monitored -> will auto-resolve when suppression window finishes.
